# COMSATSPrepHub — LLM & AI Crawler Guide (llms.txt)

> Comprehensive exam-preparation and academic planning workspace for COMSATS University students across all campuses (Islamabad, Lahore, Wah, Abbottabad, Sahiwal, Attock, Vehari).

## Core Capabilities
- **Past Papers Library (`/#subjects`):** Categorized COMSATS Midterm and Terminal past papers with model answers, topic-frequency insights, personal study notes, and PDF downloads across Computer Science (`CSC101`, `CSC102`, `CSC211`, `CSC241`, `CSC301`, `CSC311`, `CSC322`, `CSC371`, `CSC441`), Software Engineering (`SWE301`, `SWE302`, `SWE401`), Mathematics (`MTH104`, `MTH105`, `MTH231`, `MTH242`), Electrical (`EEE241`), Physics (`PHY120`), and Management (`HUM100`, `MGT101`).
- **Practice & Timed Quizzes (`/#quiz`):** Topic-based MCQs with exam timer mode, question navigator, mark-for-review, bilingual (English & Urdu / اردو) step-by-step explanations, wrong-answer review, and weak-topic drills.
- **AI Quiz Generator (`/#ai-quiz-generator`):** Custom COMSATS-style quiz creation powered by server-side Gemini, Groq, and OpenRouter fallback plus an offline question bank.
- **Study Hub (`/#study-hub`):** Daily 5-Question Challenge, Leitner spaced-repetition flashcards, bilingual course cheat-sheets, exam-date study planner, and opt-in campus leaderboard.
- **COMSATS GPA & CGPA Calculator (`/#gpa`):** Official COMSATS 4.00 grading scale calculator supporting theory/lab credits, course retakes, target CGPA calculation, and semester history charts.
- **Support, FAQ & Legal (`/#faq`, `/#terms`, `/#privacy`, `/#disclaimer`):** Guest mode support, transparent privacy controls, JSON data export/deletion, and 24-hour copyright takedown procedure.

## Official URL
https://comsatsprephub.vercel.app
